frequency_question: How often do phased intervention volumes reach maximum projected or scaled caps within 28 months of introduction?
membership_rule: Includes structured bond purchase, buyback, or quantitative easing/tightening ramping programs by G7 central banks or treasuries where initial caps or volumes were established and subsequently expanded. Excludes emergency ad-hoc lending facilities lasting less than 6 months.

cases.name: ECB APP Initial to Expanded Monthly Pace (2015-2016)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named cases; comprehensive of major systemic sovereign bond purchase/buyback scaling programs in modern regime
known_gaps: Does not fully account for rare instances where programs were aborted entirely before initial phase completion, though none occurred in major G7 debt management operations post-2008.
skeleton: 6 historical major sovereign debt/liquidity management ramping programs since 2008 tracked through their initial scaling phases
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 instances of announced programmatic scale-ups reaching targeted operational volumes within the timeframe
validity_reason: Central bank and fiscal debt management operational frameworks remain structurally consistent with post-2008 intervention playbooks.
